== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes ignore the area of effect bonus of this skill completely. Heroes will often activate this skill on recharge, or as soon as energy is sufficient.

== Notes ==
* Triple Chop makes one [[attack]] and one [[hit]] for each available target; the foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
{{anomaly|The concise description incorrectly implies a single attack hitting multiple targets.}}

== Trivia ==
* The axe in the [[skill icon]] seems to be a Canthan [[Crude Axe (Canthan)|Crude Axe]].
